plainLanguage: Sections 63 to 63A are marked repealed in the consolidated Code.
meaning: Ufafanuzi wa section 63-63A lazima ufuate complete statutory text, qualifications na procedural requirements zake; label ya offence pekee haitoshi.
keyPoints: No current substantive offence text is supplied for these section numbers.
Historical wording should not be reconstructed without authoritative historical legislation.

notes: Official text was audited before this explanation was added.
